summary: Iteration 17 - Bhakti Editor Drawer integration testing. Backend regression: 12/12 iter16 cases STILL PASS + 3 new verse-meanings tests PASS (15/15 total). Frontend Chalisa flow ALL GREEN: ?edit= auto-opens drawer, Edit-icon-click also opens drawer, 5 tabs render (Content/Verses/Audio/Audio Sync/Publish), mode-toggle visible, Beginner mode hides Audio Sync and shows Learner Mode tab, Expert restores Sync and hides Learner, Verses tab auto-edits first verse with VERSE MEANING block + Hindi/English/Sanskrit chips + verse-meaning-{code} textareas, meaning persistence verified end-to-end (POST /content/verses/:id/meanings round-trips in GET, and TEST_iter17_en_xxx written by pytest is rendered by the drawer's English chip), Publish tab renders all 6 checks (title/primary_language/verses/deity/audio/sync_map) and shows unpublish-btn (Hanuman is already published), drawer-close-btn strips ?edit= from URL. Sidebar correctly has nav-admin/bhakti/editor REMOVED and 'Bhakti Editor' label gone; bhakti-categories-toggle is the only entry-point. Legacy /admin/verse-manager, /admin/audio-sync, /admin/bhakti/editor all redirect to /admin/chalisa-manager. CRITICAL FRONTEND-BACKEND INTEGRATION BUG on Aarti (and likely all non-Chalisa categories): clicking Edit on an Aarti row opens the drawer but immediately renders 'Item not found - it may have been deleted.' with a 404 in console. Root cause: Bhakti category managers list rows from /api/bhakti/items, but BhaktiEditorDrawer fetches via /api/content/items/:id (different MongoDB collection). Hanuman Chalisa happens to exist in BOTH collections with the same _id (legacy migration), which is why Chalisa works. All bhakti_items-only items (Aarti, Namavali, Sahasranama, Stotrams, etc.) will fail.

ui_bugs.issue: Edit / View / Delete icon buttons have no data-testid (only title='Edit' on AartiManagerPage; ChalisaManagerPage has none). Add data-testid='edit-item-{id}' to make Playwright/regression tests stable.
No explicit data-testid='save-meaning-btn'. Meaning save is wired to the verse-row 'Save' button which saves both verse text + meaning together; works functionally but harder to assert in tests.

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: Drawer fetches /api/content/items/:id but the listed item._id comes from /api/bhakti/items (separate collection). Non-Chalisa items not present in content_items return 404 -> drawer shows 'Item not found - it may have been deleted.' Console logs 'Failed to load resource: 404'. Reproduced on Aarti 'Shri Ganesh Aarti'. Hanuman Chalisa works only because its _id happens to be present in BOTH collections (legacy data).

issues: Header still reports '40 verses' (cached field) while real DB count is 5 (publish-check + Verses tab show 5). Pre-existing from iter16; non-blocking but cosmetic.

action_items: P0 / CRITICAL: Make BhaktiEditorDrawer work for ALL Bhakti categories (Aarti, Namavali, Sahasranama, Vedic Mantras, Stotrams, Suktams, Ashtakam, Shatkam, Kavacham, Nam Ramayanam). Either (a) point drawer endpoints to /api/bhakti/items/:id (and cousins for verses/audio/sync/publish-check) so a single source of truth is used, or (b) backend: have /api/content/items/:id transparently fall back to bhakti_items when not found in content_items, or (c) one-time migration to mirror all bhakti_items into content_items. Without this, Edit-from-row is broken for every category except Hanuman Chalisa (and any other doc whose _id is duplicated across collections).
Add data-testid='edit-item-{item._id}' (and view-item / delete-item) to action-cell buttons in ChalisaManagerPage.js, AartiManagerPage.js, and BhaktiCategoryManager.js for testability.
Optional: reconcile cached verses_count on content_items with live count_documents (40 vs 5 mismatch on Hanuman Chalisa header) - pre-existing from iter16.
Optional: add explicit data-testid='save-meaning-btn' in the verse-edit panel for cleaner meaning-save assertions.

Publish tab returns all 6 checks; gating logic from iter16 still solid (12/12 backend pass).
Action-cell icon buttons in Chalisa/Aarti managers lack data-testids - hampers stable e2e assertions on Edit-row click.

Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_verse_meanings.py covers POST/GET/upsert verse meanings on Hanuman first-verse_id. iter16 regression /app/backend/tests/test_iter16_unified_editor.py still 12/12 pass in 2.3s. After the integration fix, retest: (1) Edit on first non-Chalisa row in each category opens drawer with full data, (2) verse meaning save round-trips via UI in any non-Chalisa category.
rca of the issue: BhaktiEditorDrawer.js was lifted from BhaktiUnifiedEditor (iter16) which was designed against the content_items API surface. When refactored to mount inside Bhakti category managers, the drawer kept its /api/content/items/* call sites but the parent pages list rows from /api/bhakti/items (separate MongoDB collection). The two collections share IDs only for legacy-migrated items (e.g., Hanuman Chalisa). Mitigation options: (A) easiest - in BhaktiEditorDrawer replace /content/items/:id with /bhakti/items/:id and verify equivalent verses / audio / sync / publish-check endpoints exist for /bhakti or proxy to content. (B) backend transparent fallback in /content/items/:id to bhakti_items collection. (C) seed migration to mirror bhakti_items into content_items. Recommendation: (A) if /bhakti/items/:id already supports verses/audio/sync; otherwise (B).
